en: The salty tang of the sea…\nIt tickles my heart.
…Sniff, sniff…\nSomething smells unpleasant…
Perhaps that reek is your sweaty\nPOKéMON's body odor…
Where are you off to in such\na hurry?
You're raising some wonderful\nPOKéMON.
If you keep going this way, you'll\neventually reach BERRY FOREST.
My mommy said that I can't swim\nwithout my float ring.
Waaah!\nWaaah!
This year, I'm going to finally\nlearn how to swim!
Yay, yay!\nPOKéMON!
What happens now?
Did I just win?\nOr did I lose?
Oh, no, don't come here!\nPlease, stay away from me!
Okay, you've won!\nNow will you please go away?
A POKéMON bit through my \nswimsuit.\pI can't get out of the water!
JOY: We'll teach you what our\nfavorite POKéMON is!
JOY: Ohh…\nMEG!
JOY: Wasn't that fun?\nI hope we can battle again!
JOY: I really want to battle with\nMEG.\pOne POKéMON isn't enough.
MEG: We'll show you our favorite\nPOKéMON.
MEG: Ohh…\nJOY!
MEG: JOY, wasn't that fun?
MEG: I want to battle together\nwith JOY.\pOne POKéMON isn't enough.
BERRY FOREST AHEAD
BOND BRIDGE\nPlease be quiet when crossing.\pBERRY FOREST AHEAD
